sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Ticket" WHERE "currentStatus"='NEW') AS "new", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Ticket" WHERE "currentStatus"='OPEN') AS "open", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Ticket" WHERE "currentStatus"='IN_PROGRESS') AS "inProgress", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Ticket" WHERE "currentStatus"='WAITING_FOR_REQUESTER') AS "waitingForRequester", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Ticket" t JOIN "User" u ON u.id=t."ownerId" WHERE u.email='staff.e2e@example.com' AND t."currentStatus" NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED')) AS "myAssigned", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "Ticket" WHERE "ownerId" IS NULL AND "currentStatus" NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED')) AS "unassigned", (SELECT count(*)::int FROM "ActionTaken" a JOIN "User" u ON u.id=a."assigneeId" WHERE u.email='staff.e2e@example.com' AND a.status='OPEN') AS "myOpenActions";
